events.title: Vince Carter's birthday
events.detail: Born in Daytona Beach, Florida.

events.title: Draft night
events.detail: Picked 5th overall by Golden State, then traded to Toronto for Antawn Jamison.

events.title: NBA debut
events.detail: 16 points in a 103-92 Raptors win at Boston after the lockout.

events.title: RIB Origin moment
events.detail: The play behind VC's RIB Origins Rare (269 minted).

events.title: Slam Dunk Contest champion
events.detail: The greatest dunk contest ever. Also the date of his ASG Legendary moment.

events.title: The dunk over Frédéric Weis
events.detail: Sydney Olympics: 'le dunk de la mort' over the 7-foot-2 French center.

events.title: Traded to the Nets
events.detail: Toronto sends Vince to New Jersey.

events.title: RIB '05-06 moment
events.detail: The play behind VC's Run It Back 2005-06 Rare (990 minted).

events.title: Vintage Vibes moment
events.detail: The play behind VC's Vintage Vibes Fandom (951 minted).

events.title: Archive moment
events.detail: The play behind VC's Archive Set (10,000 minted).

events.title: Dallas playoff game-winner
events.detail: The play behind VC's Dallas Standard, Galactic and Omega moments.

events.title: His final game
events.detail: Last shot of a 22-season career, the night the NBA shut down. The play behind his TSD and Cosmic moments.

events.title: Retirement announced
events.detail: 'I'm officially done playing basketball professionally.'

events.title: Hall of Fame class announced
events.detail: Named to the Naismith Hall of Fame class of 2024.

events.title: Hall of Fame enshrinement
events.detail: Enshrined in Springfield, Massachusetts.

events.title: Raptors retire #15
events.detail: The first jersey the Raptors ever retired.

events.title: Referral program launched
events.detail: Elite Referrers at 15% commission; public referral links promised for November.

events.title: 2025-26 roadmap: 'The New Era'
events.detail: Lower mints, the first autographs, Boxes and Cases, and moment permanence on IPFS.

events.title: Rookie Debut drop
events.detail: First drop of 2025-26: Rookie Debut /1000, Case $2,500, Box $250. This year it's /500.

events.title: Thanksgiving Deposit Match
events.detail: VIP-only match, Nov 26 to Dec 2: 15-25% back as credit. 🔁 Could return this Thanksgiving.

events.title: Rookie Origins drop
events.detail: Debut of Origins, Mojo and the Kingmaker and Skyline 1-of-1s, including a Toronto Raptors Skyline.

events.title: December Mailbag
events.detail: Top Shot owned the Dec 3 drop problems and explained its fixes.

events.title: First-ever Top Shot Breaks
events.detail: Live Case and Box breaks: $150 and $30 spots, teams drawn on-chain live on stream.

events.title: Secret Santa
events.detail: Gift any moment to TopShotSecretSanta and get one back, open to Dec 26. Top Shot called it a 'community tradition.' 🔁 Could return this Christmas.

events.title: Christmas trade-in auctions
events.detail: Two holiday auctions: top 10 won Rookie Debut packs or an Origins Box. 🔁 Could return this Christmas.

events.title: Christmas Day moments
events.detail: Top Shot This moments from the Christmas games, with packs on Dec 26.

events.title: Holo Icon and Metallic Gold LE drop
events.detail: Third roadmap drop, on time. First non-rookie autographs (Top Script).

events.title: All-Star Deposit Match, open to everyone
events.detail: Feb 9-24: 20% for everyone (up to $200), 20-35% for VIPs. 🔁 Could return around All-Star.

events.title: Team leaderboard airdrop #1
events.detail: Top team leaderboard collectors got a Rare or better pack.

events.title: Stars of 2026 drop
events.detail: Freshman Gems and Constellations, including Scottie Barnes.

events.title: Team leaderboard airdrop #2
events.detail: Second seasonal team leaderboard snapshot.

events.title: March Mayhem flash match
events.detail: Weekend-only match, Mar 13-16: 10% for everyone, 15% for VIPs. PayPal added. 🔁 Could return.

events.title: LeBron's first 1-of-1 + Signature Series
events.detail: Metallic Gold LE drop: LeBron Kingmaker, plus the first rookie Signature Series 1-of-1s.

events.title: Flagg 1-of-1 pulled in a Break
events.detail: A collector pulled the Cooper Flagg Signature Series 1-of-1, the best pull in Breaks history.

events.title: Rookie Revelation drop
events.detail: Scarcest rookie Legendaries ever: 35 per rookie.

events.title: Road to the Ring points begin
events.detail: Playoff points to spend in the Points Store. Still waiting on its return.

events.title: Top Shot This: Playoffs Edition
events.detail: $10 packs of the top play the day after each playoff game. 🔁 Could return for the playoffs.

events.title: Team leaderboard airdrop #3
events.detail: Third airdrop, completing the roadmap promise of 'at least 3.'

events.title: The Rally: community deposit match
events.detail: The rate climbed for everyone as the community locked more. 🔁 Could return.

events.title: Playoffs drop
events.detail: Run It Back Playoff Classics and more.

events.title: Every moment saved on IPFS
events.detail: Moment videos became independently verifiable forever, a big community request delivered.

events.title: The Lock-In: offseason match
events.detail: Jun 22 to Jul 2: 10% for everyone, 15% for VIPs. 🔁 Could return in the offseason.

events.title: NBA Finals drop: Knicks champions
events.detail: Knicks' first title in 53 years; Brunson Finals MVP Legendaries.

events.title: Run It Back: Origins + new Top Shot app
events.detail: First rookie 1-of-1s for 20 legends, and the first drop on the new app.

events.title: WNBA Signature Series snapshot (12 PM ET)
events.detail: #1 collector of each of the 16 partnered WNBA rookies earns her autographed Signature Series 1-of-1.

events.title: WNBA Signature Series 1-of-1 airdrop (promised)
events.detail: 16 autographed 1-of-1s to the #1 collector of each partnered rookie. Not delivered yet as of Nov 6.

events.title: Set leaderboard snapshot (12 PM ET)
events.detail: #1 on any of the 12 Rookie Debut, Season Tip-Off or Fresh Threads set leaderboards gets a guaranteed Case and Box order. Locked moments count.

events.title: Case trade-in auction opens (3 PM ET)
events.detail: Bid with Rookie Debut moments from any season. Top bid (by total average sale price) wins a Case. Closes Fri, Nov 6 at 2:30 PM ET.

events.title: Lendeborg Tip-Off Pack pre-order (until 7 PM ET)
events.detail: 1,450 packs · $10. Chase Yaxel Lendeborg's /5 and /500 Rookie Debut, LaMelo's /99 Timberwolves debut and Haliburton's /199 return.

events.title: Lendeborg trade-in auction closes (7 PM ET)
events.detail: Bid any NBA Rookie Debut, or a Haliburton/LaMelo Top Shot Debut, Rare or better. Top 25 bidders win 2 Tip-Off Packs.

events.title: Quests + early access open (3 PM ET)
events.detail: Claim your quests: complete a Rookie Debut, Season Tip-Off or Fresh Threads set, lock a Starting Five, or lock an NBA Ultimate. First to claim get guaranteed orders.

events.title: Acuff Jr. Tip-Off Pack pre-order (3 PM ET)
events.detail: 1,500 packs · $10 · max 25 per order · closes Fri, Nov 6 at 3 PM ET. Chase one of only five Darius Acuff Jr. Rookie Debut Galactic /5s, plus new Cooper Flagg and Amen Thompson Season Tip-Off /199s.

events.detail: Last chance to bid Rookie Debut moments for the Case.

events.title: Acuff Jr. Tip-Off Pack pre-order closes (3 PM ET)
events.detail: Last chance to pre-order the Acuff Jr., Flagg and Thompson Tip-Off Pack.

events.title: Caleb Wilson Tip-Off Pack pre-order opens
events.detail: 1,500 packs · max 25 per order · closes Mon, Nov 9 at 3 PM ET. One of only five Caleb Wilson Rookie Debut Galactic /5s, signed, is hidden in these packs.

events.title: Stress test trade-in auction (10:30–11 PM ET)
events.detail: 30-minute auction: trade in Rookie Debut moments, top 10 bids each won a Cam Boozer Tip-Off Pack. Every moment counted at its edition's median sale price.
